text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Planned contrasts with 99.17% intervals. Circle: seed 0, which decides the verdict. Diamond: seeds 0 to 2 together, a post hoc check. Line at 0: same score. Dashed line, -0.05: the porting threshold for C4. Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
text.tspan: Planned contrasts with 99.17% intervals. Circle: seed 0, which decides the
verdict. Diamond: seeds 0 to 2 together, a post hoc check. Line at 0: same
score. Dashed line, -0.05: the porting threshold for C4. Five Primary
substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one
every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in
points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).
